title: Content Creation - JrakeM
description: This Modpack is one of the only already made modpacks that are made for content creation
body:
# **Content Pack - JrakeM**
![Project Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16ec170ef3a33bcafa1158dd506e924e2faec437_0.webp)

This Is Ment For Fabric. Other Minecraft Types mods WILL MOST LIKELY have substitutes or might not be there.

**This ModPack Gives You Easy Capability To Record Special Scenes For Your Videos Using Different Content Mods. Containing Different Mods, Resource Packs, And Shaders Making The Game Look Better To Mods That Are Completely Content Focused.**

**It also Just Tells You What Mods You Need To Level Up Your Content**
|
**You Can View The Effect Of This By Looking At My [Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@JrakeM)**
